summary: Trail runner fell into extremely rugged terrain on Arikaree Peak (~400 ft fall); body recovered Oct 3 via short-haul helicopter after numerous failed retrieval attempts
responding_agency: Grand County SAR, Teton County SAR (short-haul), GTNP rangers, CO Army National Guard, Med Evac, Alpine Rescue Team, Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder County
notes: 31-year-old male; loose-rock cause per Grand County SAR year-end report; body recovered Oct 3, 2024 | Run-228 merge: TCSAR full news article opened (Teton County WY team + two Jenny Lake Climbing Rangers did the Oct-3-2024 short-haul recovery on Arikaree Peak, 13,146 ft; body then flown to Granby Airport via long line). | Run-349 merge: Alpine Boulder County archive (2024-116) records Alpine assist to Grand County with two Rescue Techs for the injured climber on Arikaree Peak.
